{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# Handle the special case of 999999.99 (QA orders)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and drop QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_df = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute number of converted orders and total loyal orders
num_converted = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
num_total = len(loyal_df)
conversion_rate = num_converted / num_total

# Print the computed values
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {num_total}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among loyal customers: {num_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the rate for submission
conversion_rate"}
